analysis_steps.goal: Fit dust ring model in visibilities

method.value: Axisymmetric Gaussian ring, RADMC-3D images, uvsim visibilities, emcee MCMC

evidence.quote: we compare the observations with an axisymmetric debris disc model in the Visibility space.

key_parameters.value: Free parameters: r0, h, Δr, Mdust, PA, i, RA and Dec offsets; h lower limit 0.03

evidence.quote: The free parameters in our model image and visibilities are $r_0$, $h$, $\Delta r$, $M_{\mathrm{dust}}$, PA, inclination ($i$) and RA- and decl-offset.

assumptions.value: Astrosilicate, 3.5 g/cm3, Dohnanyi q=-3.5, amin 1.3 um, amax 1 cm, kappa_abs=1.1 cm2/g at 1.3 mm

evidence.quote: We assume a Dohnanyi-like size distribution with a power law index of -3.5, and minimum and maximum grain size $a_{\min}=1.3 \mu$m and $a_{\max}=1.0$ cm.

fitting.value: emcee affine-invariant sampler, uniform priors, likelihood ∝ exp(-chi2/2)

validation.value: chi2 differs by 0.2% from MEM model; residuals consistent with noise

evidence.quote: When we compare the $\chi^2$ of our best axisymmetric model with the MEM model we find a difference of 0.2%.
